project.name: Format Rip ig-C41iECxsrZc Voiceover Montage Remix
project.description: Inspirational voiceover-montage format from ig-C41iECxsrZc. 8 stylized 4s clips (32s total) in varied art styles, all sharing the letterboxed vintage-TV window-box framing of the source. Silent generation; original 30s IG audio (voiceover + music) muxed in post via ffmpeg with -shortest, trimming output to 30s. No karaoke captions in this pass.

source.prompt:
FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with pure black bars top/bottom and small black bars left/right; the actual scene plays inside a centered ~4:3 window-box that takes up the middle 60% of the frame. Heavy 16mm film grain inside the window, soft rounded corners, subtle chromatic-aberration fringe, slight VHS-style scanline shimmer. Outside the window is solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: late-90s PS1 low-poly 3D render — chunky polygons, jagged silhouettes, flat vertex-lit shading, pixelated low-res textures, muted desaturated palette.

SCENE: low-poly young man with a brown polygonal beanie, pixelated face, dark blue baggy hoodie, leaning his shoulder and head against a flat grey concrete wall. Three-quarter side view. He is still, slightly slumped, contemplative. Camera is locked off, no movement. Subtle micro-sway in his breathing only.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with pure black bars top/bottom and small black bars left/right; the scene plays inside a centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm film grain inside, soft rounded corners, chromatic-aberration fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside is solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: expressive oil-painting portrait — visible thick brushstrokes, loose patchwork of saturated complementary colors (oranges, greens, blues), painterly impasto texture, fauvist palette, hand-painted gallery-canvas look brought to life.

SCENE: a young woman's face, three-quarter view, looking up and slightly off-camera with a quiet, melancholic expression. Olive-green hair, painterly cheeks of orange and red, blue under-eye shadow. The brushstrokes shimmer and shift very subtly as if the painting is breathing. Locked camera, no pan, no zoom.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: graphic-novel ink illustration with two-tone halftone shading — bold black contour lines, electric cyan-blue figure on a deep crimson-and-rust background, screen-print texture, occasional ink splatters and dust speckles.

SCENE: a hooded figure in a slim hoodie and joggers stands alone in a stylized courtyard, hands in pockets, head tilted slightly down. Crimson background with abstract ink-cloud forms. Locked camera, the figure breathes slightly, ink splatters drift like slow ash. No pan, no zoom.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: stop-motion claymation — visible thumbprints in the clay, slightly uneven surfaces, warm tungsten studio light, shallow depth of field, the gentle stutter of 12fps frame-by-frame animation.

SCENE: a small clay figure of a child sits cross-legged on a tiny clay floor, holding a tiny clay paper airplane, looking down at it thoughtfully. Soft beige and pastel-blue palette. The figure breathes in clay-stutter, the paper plane wobbles in their hands. Locked camera.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: loose watercolor wash painting on cold-press paper — bleeding pigments, granulating texture, hand-drawn ink contour lines on top of soft color washes, visible paper grain.

SCENE: a soft hilly landscape at dusk — rolling green-blue hills, a single small cottage with one warm-yellow window, a pale lavender sky with a thin pink ribbon of cloud. Tiny lone figure walking up a path toward the cottage. The watercolor pigments bloom and shift very slowly. Locked camera, no movement.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: 16-bit pixel art in the style of late-90s Super Nintendo RPGs — tight 32x32 tile look, dithered gradient skies, limited but evocative palette, crisp jagged pixels.

SCENE: a tiny pixel-art figure stands on the rooftop of a small pixel city at sunset, silhouetted against an orange-and-purple dithered sky. Stars begin to twinkle. A single pixel-bird flies across the screen left to right. The figure's hair pixels drift in the wind. Locked camera.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: rotoscoped hand-drawn animation — bold ink outlines tracing realistic motion, slightly wobbling line work, flat color fills in muted earth tones, paper-texture background, hand-traced indie-rotoscope feel.

SCENE: a young woman in a flowing earth-toned dress turns slowly in place, arms slightly raised, eyes closed, in a quiet meditative half-spin. Warm beige background. The wobbling rotoscope line breathes life into every frame. Locked camera, no pan.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with black bars top/bottom and small bars left/right; centered ~4:3 window-box. Heavy 16mm grain, rounded corners, chromatic fringe, VHS shimmer. Outside solid black.

STYLE INSIDE WINDOW: 90s hand-drawn anime cel — flat cel-shaded color, hand-painted background, soft chromatic grain like a VHS recording of a 90s slice-of-life anime, faint dust scratches.

SCENE: a teenage girl in a pale yellow sundress stands at the end of a wooden pier at golden hour, looking out across a calm sea. Her hair lifts slightly in the breeze. A single distant seabird drifts across the orange sky. Camera is locked off. Subtle ambient motion only — hair, water shimmer, bird drift.
